benefits.title: 1-Click Installer
benefits.text: Quickly install WordPress, Joomla, Drupal and 150+ more apps. Automatic updates keep everything current and secure.

benefits.title: Super Fast Performance
benefits.text: Speed is built in: SSD RAID-10 storage arrays, the latest PHP, built-in caching, LiteSpeed and Cloudflare CDN.

benefits.title: Friendly 24/7 Support
benefits.text: Hosting specialists are standing by 24/7 to make sure you're completely satisfied — via live chat, email or tickets.

managed.title: OS Updates
managed.text: Automated OS updates with the latest releases — at no extra cost.

managed.title: 24/7/365 Support
managed.text: Reach us any time via live chat or ticket, whichever is most convenient.

managed.title: Managed Security
managed.text: Built-in scanner and antivirus detect malicious files and respond instantly.

managed.title: Failover Systems
managed.text: Instant solutions in case of disk, RAM or any other hardware failure.

managed.title: 99.99% Uptime SLA
managed.text: Next-gen processors with SSD drives deliver an industry-leading uptime SLA.

managed.title: Remote Backups
managed.text: Automatic off-site backups restore your data in a single click after any disaster.

security.title: Attack Prevention
security.text: All traffic is monitored and threats are neutralised before they cause harm.

security.title: Vulnerability Reports
security.text: Detailed reports classify every potential and possible risk to your server.

security.text: Every server undergoes a complete security inspection when it's deployed.

security.text: Server logs are reviewed regularly to keep your environment safe and reliable.

security.title: Configured Firewall
security.text: A firewall tuned to real-world risks ships configured to avoid future issues.

whyUs.title: Simple, Quick & Easy
whyUs.text: Our packages are designed around the needs of businesses that require high-uptime hosting — perfect for both first-timers and established sites, with a solution for every requirement from basic to complex.

whyUs.title: High-Speed Web Servers
whyUs.text: Pure SSD drives make sites up to 15x faster than HDD hosting, supercharged by LiteSpeed and the Cloudflare next-gen CDN — with free DDoS protection and fast, secure DNS worldwide.

whyUs.title: Unbeatable 24/7 Support
whyUs.text: Support is the thing that matters most, and we've covered it. Our technical agents are always ready via live chat, email and tickets — 24/7/365.
